description: Defines the HttpAuthHandler class interface for handling various HTTP authentication schemes (basic, digest, NTLM, Negotiate) within the Chromium project. Includes method declarations for initializing from challenges, generating auth tokens, and handling challenges, along with relevant properties and security considerations.

classes.name: HttpAuthHandler
classes.description: Interface class for handling HTTP authentication schemes, providing methods for initialization, token generation, and challenge handling.

methods.name: InitFromChallenge
methods.description: Initializes the handler with a server challenge, storing relevant challenge data and context.

methods.name: HandleAnotherChallenge
methods.description: Handles server or proxy challenges after an initial authorization attempt.

methods.name: GenerateAuthToken
methods.description: Generates an authentication token, possibly asynchronously, for HTTP requests.

methods.name: NeedsIdentity
methods.description: Indicates whether the handler requires an identity to generate tokens.

methods.name: AllowsDefaultCredentials
methods.description: Indicates if default credentials can be used for the challenge origin.

methods.name: AllowsExplicitCredentials
methods.description: Indicates if explicit user credentials can be used.
